name: atrium
description: Open-source remote browser infrastructure for embeddable Chromium sessions

scripts.build:libs: pnpm --filter @atriumjs/protocol build && pnpm --filter @atriumjs/core build && pnpm --filter @atriumjs/express build && pnpm --filter @atriumjs/react build && pnpm --filter @atriumjs/worker build
scripts.lint: pnpm run build:libs && eslint . --max-warnings 0 && prettier --check . && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.pack:check: rm -rf .packs && mkdir -p .packs && pnpm --dir packages/protocol pack --pack-destination ../../.packs && pnpm --dir packages/core pack --pack-destination ../../.packs && pnpm --dir packages/express pack --pack-destination ../../.packs && pnpm --dir packages/react pack --pack-destination ../../.packs && pnpm --dir packages/worker pack --pack-destination ../../.packs && pnpm --dir packages/cli pack --pack-destination ../../.packs
scripts.publish:check: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm pack:check
